biological_protocol: All four biological source branches are retained. Strict I defaults to the declared raw-measurement representation, with any optional fitted transform separately typed and training-compatible. Missing exact final producers block qualified outputs; raw is a target protocol description, not permission to invent or load a new dataset. Every R paper/legacy transform remains in its exact R lane.
closure_rule: Compute transitive parent-group union, not merely caller-declared training label. TRAIN_FIT ancestors subset exact fold training groups. CALIBRATION_SELECT may inspect calibration outcomes solely to select already-fitted state; it cannot contain new numerical fit parents. FIXED_EXTERNAL_STATE needs independent frozen provenance. CASE_STATISTIC and MEASUREMENT_CASE never emit shared fitting state, never feed O15/O16 afterP05, and retain their held-query parents explicitly.
percase_vs_fitting: A frozen estimator computing an empirical covariance to estimate PR is not population-model training. Exporting that covariance as a metric/normalizer for other cases, or using it to redefine the evaluated target, is fitting and requires permitted training ancestry. This distinction applies identically to candidate and references.
raw_identity_boundary: Alignment and physical measurement can precede learning in trusted custody but are not automatically participant-visible. O09 emits stage-scoped handles; R/held handles release only afterP05. Learned normalization/metric application is fold-specific and cannot be hidden in O03-O07 common preprocessing.

records.name: canonical_ID_trial_alignment_blank_exclusion
records.rule: Verified source rules and ID metadata, no response-dependent selection; missing identity join blocks complete plan.

records.name: spontaneous_mean_SD_and32D_basis_literal_R
records.rule: Literal source uses all assigned session spont mean,sd+1e-6,eigsh32 and response projection; may include held animal only afterP05. Its state is never I input.

records.name: spontaneous_normalization_or_basis_prospective
records.rule: Fit only fold training-group spontaneous/time blocks. Parent neuron identities must match application columns; different animal neuron roster cannot use a training basis by position. If no valid coordinate join, strict I uses declared RAW_NO_SPONT protocol or records unsupported, never fits held spontaneous data.

records.name: whole_nonblank_response_centering_literal
records.rule: Legacy response minus all nonblank response mean remains literal R; final paper raw algebra remains a distinct target. No legacy state flows into I.

records.name: prospective_population_normalizer_or_center
records.rule: Only training-group responses and trial support; mean/scale/whitening/PCA parameters sealed. Cal selects among already fitted states, never updates them.

records.name: within_case_centered_moment_statistic
records.rule: Algebraic sample centering inside the frozen estimator on only this assigned matrix is allowed as its finite-sample statistic. It emits an estimate/components, not a reusable population centering state or changed target.

records.name: ROI_feature_or_neuron_selection
records.rule: External anatomical/versioned ROI fixed independently of analysis data, or training-only fitted feature selector. Held response reliability/tuning/statistics cannot select the shared feature set. A source-required full-data R selector remains R_ONLY_FIT.

records.name: LFP_filter_window_spike_binning
records.rule: Exact source-defined filter/window/units fixed before split; per-acquisition filtering permitted only within its declared held case. Data-tuned cutoffs/normalization are TRAIN_FIT. Missing final LFP/spike producer remains gated.

records.name: fMRI_measurement_beta_estimation
records.rule: Source-qualified fixed design/basis forms per-acquisition measured beta input; coefficients fit only that acquisition case, never cross-subject shared tuning. Source beta/ROI producer unknown; no invented GLM is selected. All acquisition parents retain identities and define the measured target; no generalization from raw data or training-fitted representation is claimed. If the source needs cross-case tuning, it becomes TRAIN_FIT or a descriptive/R-only branch.

records.name: LLM_tokenizer_and_checkpoint
records.rule: Exact pretrained checkpoint/tokenizer/prompt/last-token/layers frozen before corpus exposure; deterministic per-sentence encoding permitted. No adaptation to held sentences or layers/languages. All nine language translations share one semantic-group split.

records.name: LLM_whitening_feature_layer_selection
records.rule: Fit/choose using only training semantic sentence families across all their translations/layers; calibration chooses a sealed option. No held-family statistic in mean/scale/feature/layer choice. Required R all-layer outputs remain separate.

records.name: local_metric_or_covariance_pseudoinverse
records.rule: Exact metric learned only on training centers/trials with valid feature-coordinate mapping, or prespecified fixed metric. Neighborhood membership/distances under that frozen metric may use assigned evaluation rows; metric coefficients cannot be fitted from held rows for cross-fitted target. Raw paper same-sample metric retained in R-only/descriptive lane.

records.name: local_radius_center_or_weight_selection
records.rule: Entire requested radius/center/weight rule is fixed before evaluation; assignment-prescribed centers and within-case neighborhoods allowed. Learned radius/weight model fits training groups only. Insufficient neighborhoods remain typed failures; no successful-center-only averaging.

records.name: estimated_sampling_or_missingness_model
records.rule: Any estimated density/mask/weight/truncation model uses training groups only; known design probabilities are fixed metadata. Targets/positivity changes explicit; no held outcomes or protectedtruth for fitting.

records.name: estimator_internal_percase_computation
records.rule: Frozen arbitrary estimator may compute eigenvalues/covariances/iterative statistics from its query, or ephemeral internal adaptation, solely to return that case estimate. No persistent state, no later-case reuse, no new target/metric definition or training-only representation claim. Required cross-fitted metric controls still obeyTR12.

records.name: uncertainty_and_reference_equivalents
records.rule: Interval residual calibration fits only the designated training half; interval scale and reference identity selection use public calibration only. Every reference transform follows the same ancestry/feature-coordinate rules; author code does not exempt it.
